stay.name: Antonello Colonna Resort & Spa

packages.name: Dream
packages.includes: A night in a Deluxe room for two, spa access with wellness path, tasting menu dinner (drinks excluded) and breakfast
packages.when: Wednesday and Thursday only, holidays excluded; VAT included; prepaid and non-refundable

packages.name: Gourmet Night
packages.includes: Check-in after dinner, tasting menu dinner (drinks excluded), a night in a Deluxe room for two and buffet breakfast
packages.when: Wednesday and Thursday only, holidays excluded; VAT included; prepaid and non-refundable

packages.name: Dedicare
packages.includes: A night in a Deluxe (from €280) or Gran Deluxe (from €380) room, buffet breakfast, tasting menu dinner (drinks excluded), spa access and a 25-minute body treatment
packages.when: Wednesday and Thursday only, holidays excluded; VAT included; prepaid and non-refundable

packages.name: Barolo meets Champagne
packages.includes: A night in a Deluxe (from €295) or Gran Deluxe (from €325) room, buffet breakfast, tasting menu dinner, two glasses of Champagne and a bottle of Barolo, and spa access
packages.when: Wednesday and Thursday only, holidays excluded; VAT included; prepaid and non-refundable

stay.note: Twelve rooms and suites in a resort with spa and park near Rome; the stay packages run midweek only.
